title: 見つけて！私らしさと自分勝手の境界線

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the Princess Fighter show, King races in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite facing criticism, she proudly asserts that she was simply being herself. Besides, she won first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tells me to also take pride in being myself without worrying about what anyone else thinks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Behave in a way that's true to myself and don't fear hurting others! I decide to participate in the talk show at the Fan Fest as a way to show my conviction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's scary, of course, but I have someone by my side who reassures me that I'm not alone!
